ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) lateral lobes to the low-intensity (black) central peduncle and notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity diamond-shaped region tapering toward the median notch. High-intensity lateral lobes featuring high-frequency low-intensity speckling, particularly concentrated on the inner margins and upper-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 35 degrees and deep vertical penetration relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; approximately 15 distinct peaks per lobe lobe with deeper incisions and irregularities near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge boundary from the median notch extending to the pointed fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (barnacle scars) localized on the upper-left lobe and along the inner margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark horizontal linear pixel disruptions on the mid-left lobe; multiple unaligned diagonal linear streaks visible on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive complex linear and circular scarring across both lobes; significant ragged texture and loss of material along the trailing edge tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown (low-frequency chromatic) pixel clusters visible on the left lobe, indicating non-pigment surface accumulation.
